entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Little Dart Mk 17 Test Flight Report"

Flight log: the mk 17 cleared the red mesa like a dream on those new boosters and the heat tiles barely even singed. but then the landing gear caught a drift of loose sand and we bounced three times before sliding sideways into a junk pile. something definitely rattled loose in the starboard nacelle.
took the Little Dart Mk 17 up for a test flight: bumpy landing
entries.why: she's all put together and itching for the sky.
